steps.npc: I glamorous weather girl. I get weather numbers to learn how weather work.

steps.player: An unusual aspiration for a troll.

steps.npc: I like weather since I got my name. My first food gave me shiny weather number getter.

steps.text: The troll vaguely gestures in two directions at once. You manage to work out that you should try using the weather station in the following sea: [sea name].

steps.player: Can I help you with collecting weather data?

steps.npc: You take my number getter! Find where windy no do the blowing, and it get numbers. Bring numbers back to me! I try myself, but I just follow wind round in circles. Make sure you no do that!

steps.text: You hand over the troll's weather station and she promptly consumes the log book full of data.

steps.npc: Numbers so tasty. Weather here must be really good!

steps.player: Troll scientists really do operate on a higher level don't they?

steps.npc: Soon I be smart enough to speak to rocks!
